ssl.sampler: source balanced, external species uniform; recognized cabbage physical IDs uniform then scans, other species scans uniform with unresolved plant identity disclosed; XYZ-only; no future/organ labels
ssl.selection: fixed final 500; no downstream choice or weight search

budget_selection.M5A: official train only, seed17, scratch 2000-step horizon, checkpoints 0/120/500/2000
budget_selection.train_only_amendment: M5A stop rule required both variance and rank loss and missed high-variance low-rank degeneration. At 2000 pooled rank 1.525, leading eigenvalue 0.919. One documented pre-formal amendment reduces all matched runs to 500; no downstream M5 result used.
budget_selection.M5A_not_reused: S500 is a new 500-horizon run; M5A500 checkpoint had 2000-horizon schedule
budget_selection.P4_trigger: M5A500 token std <=0.5 initial and pooled rank <=0.9 initial; confirmed degeneration risk. One previously declared loss and weights only.
budget_selection.hardware_amendment: Two available physical A6000 GPUs may execute disjoint partition jobs for bounded wall time; same deterministic software and architecture; no other process killed. Not a speed benchmark.

downstream.count_head: M4 linear mean/max tokens plus 27 current geometry
downstream.count_selection: minimum validation plant-macro MAE; ties earliest
downstream.segmentation_selection: maximum validation plant-macro mIoU; ties earliest
downstream.historical_controls: reuse unmodified M4 P0/P2 20-epoch predictions/checkpoints at identical subsets/seeds; archival evidence, not new independent validation

primary.candidate_policy: P3 primary; P4 single conditional rescue, must independently pass same controls; report both, no best-task selection
primary.multiplicity: intersection of all three control gates, no averaged scans as replicates; P4 is explicitly exploratory rescue, not a second confirmatory test

semantic_risk.scope: official 100%-label auxiliary segmentation against P0; risk veto, not primary success

representation_risk.scope: CONTINUE additionally requires no near-one-dimensional or zero-variance official encoder; LIMITED still reports risk explicitly

leaf_probe.inputs: frozen pretrained tokens; labels evaluation only
leaf_probe.metric: same/different leaf cosine AUC and distance-matched centred pair margin

test_policy: No new test inference or test labels. Historical M4-informed 50% target is an exploratory hypothesis, not independent validation.
decision_policy: JEPA-CONTINUE iff P3 or conditional P4 passes all fixed primary gates and semantic veto absent; JEPA-LIMITED iff a complete expanded model has positive primary mean and >=2/3 seed directions without semantic veto; otherwise JEPA-STOP. Incomplete data/metrics cannot establish CONTINUE and must be engineering PARTIAL.
